identity_policy.limitation: Cross-provider aliases (e.g. same paper on arXiv and ACL/OpenReview) are not merged without an explicit alias. Counts are identifier-deduplicated, not guaranteed unique intellectual works.
identity_policy.exclusions: Source/repository/news records without paper identifiers or declared paper kinds are not papers.
